issue_context.title: support tiflash_hashagg_preaggregation_mode
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
this is part of tiflash `auto pass through hashagg` feature. ref https://github.com/pingcap/tiflash/issues/9196
comments: what is the meaning of `auto pass through`?

review_comments: For some agg, it may generate 3 stage aggregation, will the first 2 stage agg be treated as partial agg?

I checked some [3-stage agg plans ](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/39973/files#diff-c166335d55e8326a1db02eebad5463112a1e216968d989218c5c6b31d6cd8dc3R1208)and found most 2nd agg has no group by column. So I think the 2nd agg no need to use auto pass through
